description: AI capability center category view - reorganize the flat AI service list into categorized collapsible groups by capability type (text generation, voice, vision, knowledge retrieval, etc.) with ready/total counts per category.
steps: In apps/ajun-runtime/src/runtime-http-local-ai.ts, extend the GET /api/local-ai/control response to include a 'categories' field that groups capabilities by type. Define categories: text (text.generate), voice (audio.transcribe, audio.synthesize, audio.clone_authorized), vision (vision.analyze, video.analyze, video.generate), image (image.generate, image.edit), knowledge (embedding.create, rerank.score, knowledge.index, knowledge.search). Each category has: id, label (Chinese), capabilities (with their health status from the gateway), readyCount, totalCount.

Update the LocalAiCapabilityClient.controlOverview() method (or create a wrapper) to produce categorized output. The existing health() method already returns capabilities with healthy/e2eVerified status. Map each capability to its category.

Rewrite the aiServiceGroups function in frontend/src/app-access-views.ts to render by capability category instead of by node. Each category becomes a collapsible section (using a details/summary HTML pattern or the existing disclosure-state.ts pattern). Show category label, ready/total badge, and list services that provide capabilities in that category. Keep per-service cards with their existing controls (start/stop/restart/policy).
Add CSS classes for .ai-category-group, .ai-category-header, .ai-category-badge in the existing tokens/styles. The badge shows 'N/M ready' format.

Write test in apps/ajun-runtime/test/ai-capability-categories.test.js verifying: (1) controlOverview returns categories array, (2) each category has id, label, readyCount, totalCount, (3) capabilities are correctly grouped.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/local-ai/control returns a 'categories' array with capability groupings
Frontend renders AI capabilities in collapsible category sections instead of flat node groups
Each category shows ready/total count badge
Existing service controls (start/stop/restart/policy) still work within categories
All existing AI control tests pass
verification: npm run build:frontend --workspace=ajun-runtime && git diff --exit-code apps/ajun-runtime/public/
